foods.name: Apple
benefits: Rich in antioxidants and quercetin
Supports gut health with soluble fiber
May reduce risk of heart disease
Helps regulate blood sugar levels
Contains polyphenols that protect brain function
warnings: High in natural sugars — moderate for diabetics
Apple seeds contain amygdalin (avoid eating seeds)

foods.name: Banana
benefits: Excellent source of potassium for heart health
Boosts energy — ideal pre-workout snack
Contains tryptophan that converts to serotonin
Green bananas are rich in resistant starch
Easy to digest and gentle on stomach
warnings: High glycemic index — monitor for diabetics
High in carbohydrates — limit on low-carb diets

foods.name: Pizza
benefits: Good source of calcium from cheese
Provides quick energy from carbohydrates
Tomato sauce contains lycopene antioxidant
warnings: High in sodium — risk for hypertension
High calorie density — portion control needed
Saturated fat from cheese can raise LDL cholesterol
Refined flour crust has low nutritional value

foods.name: Salad
benefits: Very low calorie — excellent for weight management
Packed with vitamins A, C, and K
High fiber supports digestive health
Antioxidants protect against chronic diseases
Hydrating — lettuce is 95% water
warnings: Dressings can significantly increase calorie/fat content
Wash thoroughly to remove pesticide residue

foods.name: Burger
benefits: High protein content supports muscle repair
Good source of iron and zinc from beef
B vitamins support energy metabolism
warnings: Very high in sodium — exceeds 30% of daily limit
High saturated fat raises LDL cholesterol
Calorie-dense — limit frequency of consumption
Refined bun is low in fiber and nutrients

foods.name: Rice
benefits: Quick energy source — ideal for athletes
Naturally gluten-free
Easy to digest and gentle on gut
Low in fat and cholesterol
warnings: White rice is low in fiber and nutrients
High glycemic index — spikes blood sugar
Choose brown rice for more nutrients and fiber

foods.name: Egg
benefits: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Rich in choline — vital for brain health
Contains lutein and zeaxanthin for eye health
Vitamin D source — important for bone health
Highly satiating — helps with weight management
warnings: High in cholesterol — monitor if heart disease risk
Raw eggs carry salmonella risk — cook thoroughly
Egg allergy is common, especially in children

foods.name: Chicken Breast
benefits: Extremely high-protein, low-fat option
Excellent for muscle building and recovery
Rich in selenium — powerful antioxidant
Good source of B vitamins for metabolism
Versatile and easy to incorporate into meals
warnings: Skin increases fat/calorie content significantly
Processed chicken (nuggets) has added sodium
Cook to 165°F to prevent Salmonella

foods.name: Orange
benefits: Exceptional source of Vitamin C (78% daily value)
Powerful immune system booster
Flavonoids protect against heart disease
Citric acid may prevent kidney stones
High water content aids hydration
warnings: Acidic — may irritate acid reflux or GERD
Can interact with certain medications (statins)

foods.name: Sushi
benefits: Omega-3 fatty acids from fish support heart health
Nori seaweed is rich in iodine and minerals
Raw fish provides high-quality lean protein
Wasabi has antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties
warnings: High sodium from soy sauce — watch for hypertension
Raw fish risk for pregnant women and immunocompromised
Mercury content in tuna — limit consumption

foods.name: Avocado
benefits: Heart-healthy monounsaturated fats (oleic acid)
Exceptionally high in potassium (more than banana)
Loaded with fiber for digestive health
Improves absorption of fat-soluble vitamins
Contains folate important for cell function
warnings: High in calories — portion control important
High fat content (though mostly healthy fats)
Avocado allergy exists in some individuals

foods.name: Milk
benefits: Excellent calcium source for bone health
High-quality complete protein
Fortified with vitamin D for calcium absorption
Riboflavin and B12 support energy metabolism
warnings: Lactose intolerance affects ~68% of adults worldwide
Whole milk is high in saturated fat
Dairy allergy is distinct from lactose intolerance

foods.name: Broccoli
benefits: Sulforaphane may have potent anti-cancer properties
135% of daily Vitamin C per cup
Excellent source of Vitamin K for blood clotting
Supports liver detoxification
Anti-inflammatory glucosinolates
warnings: Can cause bloating and gas in some people
High Vitamin K may interact with blood thinners

foods.name: Pasta
benefits: Good source of sustained energy
B vitamins for energy metabolism
Low fat content
Whole grain pasta significantly boosts fiber
warnings: High glycemic index spikes blood sugar
Portion sizes are often underestimated
Sauce can dramatically increase calories/sodium

foods.name: Chocolate
benefits: Dark chocolate is rich in antioxidants (flavonoids)
May improve heart health and blood flow
Magnesium and iron content
Can improve mood by releasing endorphins
warnings: High in sugar and saturated fat
Calorie-dense — easy to overconsume
Caffeine content — avoid before sleep
Toxic to pets (dogs, cats)

90-100.label: Excellent
90-100.description: Nutrient-dense superfood with exceptional health benefits

75-89.label: Very Good
75-89.description: Highly nutritious with significant health benefits

45-59.label: Fair
45-59.description: Some nutritional value but consume in moderation
